representativeMonths.description:
Profile `ageBands[]` only (DSP-2, 1.3.0): the `ageMonths` a session in this band
carries; absent means `(minMonths + maxMonths) / 2`. Never written in a baselines
document's `ageBrackets`.

AnalysisDefinition.description:
The snapshot a run is computed from (`analysis_runs.definition`, RUN-1);
`definition_hash = sha256(JCS(definition))`.

profile.description: The experiment profile at enqueue time.

AnalysisEncoding.description: RUN-7: file encoding of an `analysis_results` export (`parquet` for `sessions` only).

AnalysisExport.description: `analysis_results` only (RUN-7): the run and the table to export.

AnalysisLayout.description: RUN-7: which table of an analysis run an `analysis_results` export carries.

AnalysisRun.description:
`GET /v1/analysis-runs/{id}` (`AnalysisRead`): every RUN-1 column but the result blob
key. The reproducibility fields (RUN-5) are set before the job starts.

membership_drift.description: Set on a re-run once it finished (RUN-2).

AnalysisRunRequest.description:
`POST /v1/orgs/{id}/analysis-runs` (`AnalysisRun`; RUN-2). Exactly one of `cohort_id`
and `cohort`. Answers `202 AnalysisRun`.

seed.description: Bootstrap seed; the server draws one when absent and stores it (RUN-5).

AnalysisSessionRow.description:
`GET /v1/analysis-runs/{id}/sessions` item (RUN-3, PRV-2): no token, MRN, name or device
model.

dwellCapMs.description: Longest interval one frame contributes to a dwell sum, milliseconds.

marginNorm.description: Grows (positive) or shrinks (negative) every AOI box, normalised screen units.

Attachment.description:
One attachment's metadata (REC-6). The bytes are read with `GET /v1/attachments/{id}`
(`ClinicalContentRead`, REC-7).

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the plaintext; `null` until the content is uploaded (REC-7).

AttachmentMediaType.description:
REC-6: the only accepted media types; anything else is `400
attachment-type-not-allowed`.

AttachmentPage.description:
`GET /v1/participants/{id}/attachments` (REC-6, WP-B.19). `total` is the
participant's live attachment count when the server computes it.

CareEventInput.description: One care event of a batch.

idempotency_key.description:
Per-event key, unique per org: an event whose key was stored before is counted as a
duplicate and not stored again.

occurred_at.description: When it happened (RFC 3339); the server's receive time when absent.

payload.description:
Free-form event body. Tasks carry `task_id` and optional `metadata.type`
(`session`, `checkin`); diary entries carry `mood`. Must be a JSON object.

duplicate.description: True when the whole batch was a replay of an earlier `X-Idempotency-Key`.

duplicates.description: Events skipped because their `idempotency_key` was already stored.

CareSummary.description:
`GET /v1/participants/{token}/summary`: counts over the participant's care events. An
unknown token answers all zeros (the old CareKit summary did the same).

completion_rate_percent.description: 100 when any task was completed, else 0 (the CareKit port's rule).

recent_moods.description: Distinct diary moods, newest first (at most 10).

session_count.description: Task events whose `task_id` contains `session` or whose `metadata.type` is `session`.

CaseShareRequest.description:
`ExportRequest.case` for `format: case_package` (SHR-7): one participant per package.
Identified mode needs `consent_reference` and `consent_recorded_at`, else `400
case-consent-missing`.

consent_reference.description: ≤ 200 characters, clear (an identifier such as a consent form number).

session_ids.description: Sessions to include; empty means all of the participant's sessions.

assigned_to.description: Assign to this user of the org instead of the caller.

ClinicalNote.description: A clinical note. Append-only: a correction is a new note with `corrects_id`.

corrected_by.description: The id of the note that corrects this one, if any (shown struck through).

ClinicalNoteKind.description: NOTE-1: a correction is a new note pointing at the corrected one.

ClinicalReview.description: `GET /v1/clinical-reviews/{id}` and the result of every review mutation.

content_hash.description:
Hex SHA-256 of the current version's snapshot; sign and cosign must echo it
(SIGN-4).

current.description: The version being edited or the latest signed one.

ClinicalReviewSnapshot.description:
SIGN-4: exactly what the signer saw. `content_hash = SHA-256(JCS(snapshot))`. Every field
is serialised (absent values as `null`), so adding a field to this type changes every
hash: version it rather than editing it.

ClinicalReviewVersion.description: One version of a review's content.

amend_reason.description: SIGN-8 reason of an amendment version; absent without `ClinicalContentRead`.

ClinicalSignature.description:
One signature (SIGN-5, SIGN-6). The name and registration are a snapshot taken at
signing (signature manifestation).

content_hash.description: Hex SHA-256 of the signed snapshot.

ClipScore.description:
`GET /v1/sessions/{id}/clips` item: the stored per-clip row plus its metric rows. The
flat `metric/expected/recorded/deviation/baseline_ref` columns come from the worst-status
row (ties: largest |deviation|), all `null` for a clip without rows (CON-19).

status.description: Worst row status; `null` for a clip with no scored rows.

definition_hash.description: sha256 of the RFC 8785 form of `definition`, hex.

CohortBandCount.description: One age band of a cohort preview; counts are `null` when suppressed (PRV-1, AGE-3).

frames_n.description: Sessions of the band with a research frame log.

CohortDefinition.description:
Which sessions a run reads (COH-1). Research consent, "not withdrawn" and
`capture_source = truedepth` are always applied and cannot be expressed here. Every list
empty = no restriction. `cohort_hash = sha256(JCS(definition))`.

age_bands.description: Band ids of the experiment profile's `ageBands`.

include_synthetic.description: Synthetic sessions too; honoured only with `ASD_ALLOW_SYNTHETIC`, flagged in results.

require_frames.description: Only sessions with a research frame log.

sex.description: Applied only once sessions carry sex (ADR-0012 Q8).

CohortExclusions.description: Sessions left out of a cohort, by reason (COH-2).

n.description: `null` when the whole cohort is below `small_cell_k`.

small_cell_k.description: The org's suppression threshold applied to this answer (PRV-1).

ConfigBundle.description:
The signed bundle served by `GET /v1/config/bundle` (CON-5, CON-6).

`signature` is `ed25519:` + base64url (no padding) of the Ed25519 signature over the
RFC 8785 canonical form of this object with the `signature` member removed; `key_id`
names the signing key so keys can rotate. Use [`crate::signing`] to sign and verify.
ConfigBundle.title: ConfigBundle

ConfigDocumentStatus.description: Lifecycle `draft -> candidate -> published -> retired`; only `published` is bundled.

CreateAttachmentRequest.description:
`POST /v1/participants/{id}/attachments` (REC-7, `AttachmentWrite`): metadata first,
then the bytes with `PUT` to `AttachmentUpload.upload.url`.

file_name.description: Sanitised by the server; ≤ 120 characters after sanitising.

session_ids.description: Sessions of the same participant to link on create.

CreateExperimentRequest.description:
`POST /v1/orgs/{id}/experiments` (`ExperimentWrite`). Starts from the published profile
unless `from_experiment_id` or `from_version` names another (at most one of them).

CreateParticipantRequest.description:
`POST /v1/orgs/{id}/participants` (REC-1, `ParticipantCreate`). The token is minted by
the server (`participant_token_from_uuid`), never supplied; `mode` is always `clinic`.

consent_version.description: The consent the clinic recorded on paper or in the app.

CreatedParticipant.description:
`201` answer to `POST /v1/orgs/{id}/participants` (REC-1): the `Participant` keys plus
`qr_payload` (`asd://participant/<token>?org=<org_id>`, see `qr_payload`).

has_patient_ref.description:
Whether a hospital MRN is on file (MRN-5/6). Absent for a caller without
`PatientRefRead`; the MRN itself is never in this type.

CreatedShareLink.description:
`201` answer to `POST /v1/exports/{id}/share-link` (SHR-8). The passcode is returned
this once and never stored or returned again.

DatasetExportRequest.description:
`POST /v1/jobs/export-dataset` (WP-B.9, 02 §4): a de-identified research dataset of the
caller's org. Same as `POST /v1/orgs/{id}/exports` with `mode = deidentified`,
`purpose = research` (only research-consented sessions) and a dataset format; answers
`202` with the [`Export`], downloaded through `POST /v1/exports/{id}/download-url`.

reason.description: 10..500 characters, shown in the audit log.

DeliverableDestination.description:
A destination an exporter may choose (`GET /v1/orgs/{id}/export-destinations`,
`ExportRead`): identity and state only, never config or secrets.

DeliverableDestinationList.description: `GET /v1/orgs/{id}/export-destinations`: the org's active destinations, oldest first.

Delivery.description: One delivery of an export to a destination (DLV-1, DLV-5).

last_error_class.description: Enum spelling only, never remote text.

oneOf.description: A requested export is ready to download.
A clinical review was finalised; its export is ready (DLV-6).

DeliveryTrigger.description: INTG-3 `trigger`: `on_final_sign` delivers every finalised clinical review (DLV-6).

Disclosure.description: One export that included the participant (EXJ-6, accounting of disclosures).

session_ids.description: The participant's sessions in the export.

DisclosureDelivery.description: One delivery of an export (DLV-5), as listed with a disclosure.

DisplayParams.description:
`display` (DSP-1, 1.3.0): the result screens' band cut-offs and the scanpath gap. Read by
the device views through `asd_core::display::band`; no stored value depends on it.

scanpathMaxGapMs.description: The scanpath line breaks across a sample gap longer than this, milliseconds.

Disposition.description: SIGN-2: the clinician's statement. Never pre-filled from the attention flag.

Dist.description:
A distribution summary (RUN-4). With `suppressed: true` every other field is `null`
(PRV-1); `p10`/`p90` are `null` below [`MIN_N_FOR_DECILES`].

ci95_mean.description: Bootstrap 95 % CI of the mean (seeded, RUN-5).

DistComparison.description: Published, draft and draft-minus-published distributions of one quantity.

DocumentKind.description: The config document a parameter lives in. Only the scoring profile carries knobs today.

DownloadUrl.description:
`POST /v1/exports/{id}/download-url` (EXJ-5): a pre-signed GET (absolute) or a relative
`/v1/exports/{id}/file?t=...` (proxy blob mode), valid five minutes.

DwellUnits.description: Units of the `dwell_*` columns. Ratios of valid clip samples, never seconds (CON-13).

EffectiveConfig.description:
`GET /v1/orgs/{id}/config/effective` (`ConfigRead`, GOV-6): what the org's devices and
the console render from (INV-2).

EffectiveDocument.description: One published document of the effective configuration.

EffectiveSource.description: Where the effective configuration came from.

Encounter.description:
REC-4: one encounter. `kind`, `reason` and `summary` are staff input, never pre-filled
from the attention flag or a score (REC-10).

clinician_display_name.description: REC-5: the clinician's display name, for the timeline header.

has_summary.description: Whether a summary exists, for callers that may not read it (REC-4).

session_ids.description: Linked sessions of the same participant (REC-4).

EncounterStatus.description:
REC-3: `encounters.status`. A `closed` encounter accepts only `follow_up_done_at`;
`owner` or `clinician` may reopen it (REC-4, `409 encounter-closed` otherwise).

EnrolCodeResponse.description: The new enrol code; the plain code is returned only here.

ErasureOutcome.description: What one erasure removed (`erasure_requests.outcome`). Counts only, never identifiers.

attachments_deleted.description:
Attachments deleted with their blobs (REC-7). Absent in outcomes recorded before
EMR-lite.

clinical_drafts_deleted.description: Unsigned clinical drafts (review drafts, draft letters) deleted.

export_artifacts_deleted.description: Unexpired export artifacts that included the participant, deleted (EXJ-8).

session_blobs_deleted.description: Frames and report blobs deleted (absent keys count too: the store cannot tell).

sessions_deleted.description: Sessions deleted with their clips, review-queue items and labels.

sessions_held.description: Sessions kept because a held clinical record documents them.

duplicate.description: True when an open request already existed and is returned unchanged.

executed_at.description: When the erasure job last ran for this request.

ErasureRequestResponse.description:
`POST /v1/participants/{token}/erasure`: the stored request (execution is a job,
WP-B.9). Consent is withdrawn at once, so no new data is accepted for the participant.

duplicate.description: True when an open request already existed and is returned unchanged.

ErasureStatus.description:
`erasure_requests.status`.

- `pending`: filed, the erasure job has not finished;
- `completed`: everything about the participant was erased; the participant row stays as
  a tombstone (`erased_at`, withdrawn, demographics cleared) so replayed uploads stay
  refused;
- `held`: the participant has signed clinical records (signed or superseded review
  versions, clinical notes, finalised letters). Everything else was erased; the held
  records, the sessions they document and the MRN mapping stay until the owner decides
  ADR-0008 Q2 (retention versus erasure of clinical records).

Experiment.description: A named draft scoring profile of an org (EXP-1).

base_profile_version.description: The published profile version the experiment started from.

baselines_version.description:
Baselines version (published or draft) the experiment scores against; `null` = the
published one.

profile_hash.description: sha256 of the RFC 8785 form of `profile`, hex.

promoted_config_version.description: The draft config document created by promote (GOV-2).

Export.description: An export (EXJ-1..4). Never carries clinical content: counts, hashes and the request.

examples.reason: Quarterly research extract for the ethics-approved cohort study

error.description: Short error class when `failed`; never patient data.

include_labels.description: Dataset formats: the artifact carries reviewer labels (WP-B.9).

share_links_n.description: `case_package`: share links created for this export (SHR-8), revoked included.

ExportFilters.description:
EXJ-1 filters: the session-list filters plus id and clinical-state lists. Every field
is optional; an empty filter selects every session of the org.

action_prefix.description:
`audit_csv` only (HIP-3): rows whose `action` starts with this prefix (e.g.
`export.`). Refused on other formats.

actor_id.description: `audit_csv` only (HIP-3): rows of this acting user (UUID). Refused on other formats.

clinical_state.description:
Clinical review states (`open`, `final`, ...); `none` selects sessions without a
clinical review.

from.description: `started_at` lower bound: RFC 3339 or `YYYY-MM-DD` (start of day, UTC).

reviewed.description: Whether the session has a finished review-queue item.

to.description: `started_at` upper bound: RFC 3339 or `YYYY-MM-DD` (end of day, UTC).

ExportFormat.description:
EXJ-1 artifact format. `csv`, `csv_excel`, `csv_sheets`: ZIP of the four tables
plus `manifest.json` in the three CSV dialects (CSV-1, CSV-3); `xlsx`: one workbook
(XLSX-1); `pdf_summary`: PDF/A clinical summary (WP-I.5, not available yet);
`fhir_bundle`: one FHIR R4 clinical report bundle, exactly one session
(`filters.session_ids`); `fhir_ndjson`: one bundle per line, any number of sessions;
`hl7v2`: one ORU^R01 message, exactly one session, identified only (HL7-7).
`dataset_jsonl`, `dataset_parquet`: de-identified ML datasets, one row per session,
labels when `include_labels` (WP-B.9; de-identified only).
`case_package`: one participant's case as a ZIP (SHR-1..7, `ExportRequest.case`);
`audit_csv`: the org's audit log as canonical CSV (HIP-3, `AuditExport`).
`analysis_results`: the aggregates or per-session rows of an analysis run
(`ExportRequest.analysis`, RUN-7; de-identified, research or quality improvement).

ExportKind.description: `exports.kind`: a stored job artifact or a single synchronous document render (EXJ-7).

ExportMode.description:
EXJ-1: identified (token, MRN and clinical text where the requester may read them) or
de-identified (XC-4).

ExportPurpose.description: EXJ-1: why the export is made; decides which modes and sessions are allowed (XC-5).

case.description: `case_package` only (SHR-7): the participant, recipient and consent of the case.

include_labels.description:
Dataset formats only (WP-B.9): add each session's reviewer labels. Ignored by the
other formats.

reason.description: 10..500 characters, shown in the audit log.

ExportStatus.description:
`exports.status`. `expired`: the artifact was deleted after `expires_at`; the
accounting stays (EXJ-4).

FlagRateComparison.description: Flag rates of one band, published and draft.

FlagRates.description: Flag shares in `[0, 1]`; the whole object is `null` for a suppressed band.

atypicalShareForRed.description: Share of atypical rows that forces red even with a high composite.

greenFloor.description: Composite at or above which the flag can be green.

lowConfidenceShare.description: Share of scored clips below the quality gate that forces yellow.

yellowFloor.description: Composite below which the flag is red.

FollowUp.description:
One open follow-up (REC-4: `GET /v1/orgs/{id}/follow-ups?due_before=&assigned=`): an
encounter with `follow_up_due_at` set and `follow_up_done_at` unset. No summary.

GazeSessionRecord.description:
The full on-device record (`GazeSessionRecord.swift`), carried as `rawPayload`.

Dates are RFC 3339 UTC strings with milliseconds (`2026-10-26T07:33:20.000Z`), as
`SessionPayloadCoding` writes them. Keys this type does not know (for example a future
`bundleVersion` or `normCollection`) are kept in [`GazeSessionRecord::extra`] and written
back unchanged, so `sessions.summary` stores the record without loss.

participantId.description: Pseudonymous participant token, never a name (CNS-7).

schemaVersion.description: Record form (`"v1.6"`); the wire form drops the `v`.

Hist.description: Histogram of a distribution: `counts[i]` values in `[edges[i], edges[i + 1])`.

HousekeepingRequest.description:
`POST /v1/jobs/housekeeping` (superadmin): queues a manual housekeeping sweep and
answers `202` with the job (`GET /v1/jobs/{id}`). An empty object is a real run.

dry_run.description: Count what the sweep would remove without removing anything (default `false`).

HousekeepingResult.description:
`jobs.result` of a `housekeeping_sweep` job: rows removed (or, in a dry run, removable)
per rule.

enrol_codes.description: `enrol_codes` revoked or expired more than 90 days ago that no device references.

jobs.description: Finished `jobs` older than 30 days that nothing references.

refresh_tokens.description: `refresh_tokens` expired more than a day ago.

totp_pending.description: Users whose expired pending TOTP enrolment was cleared.

Integration.description:
A delivery destination (INTG-1). Secrets never appear: `has_secret` and the first 8 hex
of the secret's SHA-256 (INTG-2); for SFTP, the public key it authenticates with.

last_test_error.description: Short error class of the last failed test (INTG-4).

ssh_public_key.description: sftp: OpenSSH public key to install at the hospital (INTG-5).

IntegrationConfig.description:
INTG-3 destination settings. One shape for every kind; the backend checks which keys a
kind needs. Unknown keys are refused, so nothing secret can be smuggled into `config`
(secrets go through `PUT /v1/integrations/{id}/secret`, INTG-2).

events.description:
webhook: events the receiver wants (default: all). Auto-deliveries (DLV-6) go only
to webhooks that accept `review.finalized`.

file_prefix.description: sftp: prefix of dropped file names (`[A-Za-z0-9._-]`).

host_key_sha256.description:
sftp (INTG-5, mandatory): the server's host key fingerprint as printed by
`ssh-keygen -lf` (`SHA256:<base64>`). Pinned: a mismatch fails the delivery.

mode.description: Mode of auto-deliveries; DLV-6 auto-exports are `identified`.

remote_dir.description: sftp: absolute directory the files are dropped in.

url.description: webhook: `https://` receiver URL, no user info (DLV-3).

IntegrationKind.description:
INTG-1 destination kind. `fhir_server` (WP-I.9) and `hl7_mllp` (WP-I.11) are refused
until their channels exist.

IntegrationStatus.description: INTG-1: a `disabled` destination is never delivered to.

IntegrationTestResult.description:
`POST /v1/integrations/{id}/test` (INTG-4): a synthetic delivery (token `TEST-0000`, no
participant data). Never carries the remote response body.

error_class.description: Short error class when not ok (`connect-failed`, `host-key-mismatch`, ...).

remote_ref.description: E.g. `http 204` or the dropped file path.

name.description: JSON pointer or field name, e.g. `sessionId` or `/perVideo/0/dwell_social`.

IvtUnit.description: Unit of the I-VT velocity threshold (`metrics.ivtUnit`).

oneOf.description: Normalised viewport units per second (`metrics.ivtVelocityUnitsPerSec`): today's rule.

Degrees of visual angle per second (`metrics.ivtVelocityDegPerSec`, SCR-3; owner gate
H-G2).

JobProgress.description: Progress of a running job (RUN-8): `jobs.progress`, written with the heartbeat.

LabelInput.description: A human annotation attached by a reviewer.

LetterSnapshot.description: NOTE-3: what a letter's finalizer signs.

Level.description: The level a session was actually evaluated at.

LevelCounts.description: Sessions by the level a run would evaluate them at (RPX-3).

LevelRequest.description: Requested evaluation level (RPX-3): `auto` = frames where a research log exists.

LinkSessionRequest.description: `POST /v1/encounters/{id}/sessions` (REC-4): link a session of the same participant.

Locale.description:
A console and backend locale (I18N-14): stored in `users.locale` and
`organizations.default_locale` (migration 0028).

LoginRequest.description:
`POST /v1/auth/login`.

Two-step for a user with TOTP enrolled (AUTH-1): the first request carries `email` and
`password` only; when both are right the answer is `401` problem `totp-required`. The
client asks for the authenticator code and sends the same request again with
`totp_code`. A wrong, expired or already used code answers `401` problem `totp-invalid`.
Both legs count against the per-IP login limit; requests with a code also count
against a per-user limit (10 per minute, `429` + `Retry-After`).

totp_code.description:
Current RFC 6238 code (6 digits) from the user's authenticator app. Needed only
when the user has TOTP enrolled; ignored otherwise. Each code is accepted once.

MeanMedian.description: Mean and median of one quantity in a sweep cell.

MembershipDrift.description: Sessions added and removed between a run and its re-run (RUN-2, RUN-6).

MetricRow.description: One scored expected-vs-recorded cell of a clip (CON-19).

deviation.description: `recorded - expected`; `null` when there is no expected value.

MetricsParams.description: Fixation and affect extraction parameters (PRM-7). Defaults are the asd-core constants.

fallbackFrameIntervalSec.description: Frame interval assumed where timestamps do not give one (60 Hz).

flatAffectGain.description: Gain of the flat-affect score (`1 - mean expressivity x gain`, clamped to [0, 1]).

ivtVelocityDegPerSec.description: I-VT threshold in degrees per second (`ivtUnit = deg`).

ivtVelocityUnitsPerSec.description: I-VT threshold in normalised viewport units per second (`ivtUnit = norm`).

smileReactivityWindowSec.description: Window after a clip onset in which a smile counts as reactive, seconds.

includeImputed.description: Whether rows flagged `imputed` enter the distributions.

minN.description: Fewest observations a norm cell (and an analysis band, AGE-3) needs.

research_frames_retention_months.description:
RFL-5: retention horizon of the research frame log, `1..=240` months. Omitted when
the org follows `retention_months`. Present on `GET`/`PATCH /v1/orgs/{id}`.

settings.description:
`organizations.settings` (non-secret keys only: secret-looking keys are refused on
write and filtered here). Present on `GET /v1/orgs/{id}`; absent in `GET /v1/orgs`.

default_locale.description: I18N-11: the org's default locale (`OrgUpdate`: owner, admin). Absent = unchanged.

research_frames_retention_months.description:
RFL-5, `1..=240` months (validated by the route like `retention_months`). Absent =
unchanged (`None`), `null` = follow `retention_months` (`Some(None)`), a number = the
log's own horizon.

display_name.description: Signer profile (NOTE-6); staff data, stored in clear.

ParamKind.description:
Value type and allowed range (PRM-1). `AgeBands` is the one structured kind: the profile's
`ageBands` list (contiguous, ascending, inclusive month bounds).

oneOf.description: Screen-normalised `[x, y]` points, each coordinate in `[0, 1]`.

`[{id, minMonths, maxMonths, representativeMonths?}]`: ids unique, bands contiguous and
ascending, `minMonths <= representativeMonths <= maxMonths` (DSP-2, 1.3.0).

id.description: camelCase dotted wire path in the document.

ownerGate.description:
Owner decision fencing the knob for clinical use (e.g. `H-G2`); analysis may still
vary it (ADR-0012 open question 9).

since.description: Profile schema version that introduced the parameter.

has_patient_ref.description:
Whether a hospital MRN is on file (MRN-5/6). Absent for a caller without
`PatientRefRead`; the MRN itself is never in this type.

ParticipantIdentity.description:
Wave-3 participant identity (REC-9). Type only: no route stores or returns it before
wave 3, and `identity-disabled` answers any attempt. The keys are frozen now; do not
rename them.

ParticipantSearchRequest.description:
`POST /v1/orgs/{id}/participants/search` (REC-2, `ParticipantRead`). Every filter is
optional; `mrn` needs `PatientRefRead` and is sent in the body only (MRN-4). Identity
fields are not searchable before wave 3.

ParticipantSearchRow.description:
One search result (REC-2): the `Participant` keys plus the record counters. REC-2's
`sessions_n` and `last_session_at` are `Participant.session_count` and
`Participant.last_session_at`.

has_patient_ref.description:
Whether a hospital MRN is on file (MRN-5/6). Absent for a caller without
`PatientRefRead`; the MRN itself is never in this type.

PatientRefSearchRequest.description: `POST /v1/orgs/{id}/patient-refs/search`: the MRN travels in the body only (MRN-4).

PatientRefSearchResponse.description: Search result: the matching participant, or `null`.

ProblemSlug.description: Problem slugs defined by the contract: `Problem.type` is `https://schemas.curv.org/asd/problems/<slug>`. Routes may add their own (e.g. `email-taken`, `last-owner`).

PromoteExperimentRequest.description:
`POST /v1/experiments/{id}/promote` (`ExperimentPromote`, GOV-2): creates a **draft**
config document of `kind` (`scoring_profile` or `normative_baselines`).

PutIntegrationSecretRequest.description:
`PUT /v1/integrations/{id}/secret` (INTG-2, webhook only): `whsec_` + base64 of 24..64
random bytes. Write-only: never returned, logged or audited.

Ready.description:
`GET /health/ready` (DB and blob store, CON-22). `status` is `ok` only when every
check is `ok`; the HTTP status is 503 otherwise.

content_hash.description: Hex SHA-256 of the letter snapshot; finalize must echo it.

RegisterDeviceRequest.description: `POST /v1/devices/register` body as the iOS app sends it.

device_id.description:
Sent on re-registration: the server rotates this device's token without consuming
a use of the code (CON-11).

config_bundle_version.description: Latest bundle for the org, `null` when none is published.

device_token.description: `dvc_` + 32 random bytes base64url; shown once, stored hashed.

RegistrationStatus.description: Whether a registration created a device or rotated an existing device's token.

Reprocess.description: What a changed value needs before it shows in a result (RPX-3).

oneOf.description: Re-scoring the stored per-clip rows is enough.
Metrics must be re-extracted from frames.
The raw samples must be replayed (research frame log).
Only a new capture can show it (device behaviour during the session).

ResearchFramesState.description: Whether a session's research frame log (RFL-1, RFL-3) is stored (RFL-6).

available.description: A sealed log is stored and can be read with `GET /v1/sessions/{id}/research-frames`.

bytes.description: Size of the uploaded log, bytes.

purged.description: The retention sweep deleted the log (RFL-5).

cutoff.description: Sessions received before this instant are past retention.

frames_purged.description: Sessions whose frames blob was (or, in a dry run, would be) deleted.

research_frames_purged.description: Sessions whose research frame log was (or, in a dry run, would be) deleted (RFL-5).

dry_run.description: Count what the sweep would delete without deleting anything (default `true`).

session.description:
Short summary of the session, so the console needs no call per item. Present in
the list; absent from write responses.

ReviewParams.description:
Backend review rules (INV-1 backend rows): the valid-frame ratio below which a session is
queued for review as low quality (`auto_review`), also the norm job's session floor.

ReviewReason.description: Why a session entered the review queue.

ReviewSessionSummary.description: The session fields shown beside a review item.

Role.description: RBAC role: org-scoped roles plus the global `superadmin` (AUTH-4).

params_not_applied.description: Registry id -> sessions where the knob could not be applied at their level (RPX-3).

metrics.description: Metric keys to summarise; empty = the 15 metric keys and the composite.

RunSummary.description: `analysis_runs.summary` (RUN-4, ≤ 1 MiB), PRV-1 applied before it is stored.

age_profile.description: `age_profile` runs only (AGE-1, phase B: shape owned by WP-X.9).

small_cell_k.description: The small-cell threshold the summary was suppressed with.

ScoringProfile.description: Scoring parameters delivered in the bundle (`scoring_profile` config document).

ageBands.description:
Age bands of norms and analysis (PRM-7, AGE-2): contiguous, ascending, 1..=12 bands,
months 0..=240. Absent before 1.2.0: the five `asd_core::norms` brackets.

display.description: Result-screen band cut-offs (DSP-1, 1.3.0). Display only: no stored value depends on it.

lowConfidenceValidRatio.description: Clips below this valid-sample ratio are low-confidence.

metrics.description: Fixation and affect extraction (PRM-7, 1.2.0). Absent before 1.2.0: today's constants.

sessionQuality.description:
Session verdict ratios (DSP-1, DSP-4, 1.3.0): the stored `qualityVerdict` of new
sessions.

trackingQuality.description: Gaze-robustness thresholds (SCH-3). Absent in a 1.0.0 profile: the asd-core defaults.

ScoringStatus.description: Whether on-device scoring produced the session's scores.

SessionAttentionFlag.description: Backend-derived flag: the device enum plus `unreliable` (CON-15).

SessionDelta.description: Draft minus published of a per-session row.

participant_token.description: The pseudonymous token the device sent (CON-20).

research_frames.description:
The research frame log of the session (RFL-6). Omitted (not `null`) when unknown, so
the export record built from this type keeps its bytes (PRV-5: never exported).

scoring_status.description:
SCH-5 scoring outcome of a schema 1.8 session; `null` for a 1.6 or 1.7 session (those
always carry score numbers). `unscorable`: the session has no scores; show "not
scored", never a number.

tracking_accuracy_deg.description: QS-2 estimated gaze accuracy, degrees; `null` when not measured (SCH-4).

tracking_quality.description:
The session's tracking-quality record (QS-1, snake_case); `null` for a 1.6 session
(app version before tracking quality) or without a record (SCH-4).

tracking_verdict.description:
QS-4 tracking verdict of a schema 1.7 session; `null` for a 1.6 session or when the
device sent no tracking-quality record (SCH-4).

unscorable_reason.description: Why an `unscorable` session was not scored, when the device said; `null` otherwise.

SessionIngestRequest.description: Curv Pediatric ASD Gaze Session Ingestion Schema (v1.6)

attentionFlag.description:
Explicit `null` when the device did not compute a flag; the server then derives it
(CON-15). `None` = key absent, `Some(None)` = `null`.

battery.description: Catalog protocol id (`express_30s`, CON-16) or explicit `null` when unknown.

schemaVersion.description: Wire form (`"1.6"`), equal to the `X-Schema-Version` header (CON-21).

SessionIngestRequest.title: SessionIngestRequest

SessionIngestResponse.description:
`POST /v1/sessions` success body. Key casing follows the iOS decoder
(`sessionId`, `frames_upload_url`). A replay returns the original body with
`duplicate: true` (CON-17). Upload URLs are absolute pre-signed URLs or relative
`/v1/sessions/{id}/blobs/{frames|report}` paths (CON-18); `null` when no upload is wanted.

research_frames_upload_url.description:
RFL-3: where to `PUT` the research frame log (relative proxy path
`/v1/sessions/{id}/blobs/research_frames`). Offered only in proxy blob mode and only
for a research-consented session; omitted otherwise. Not part of the stored
idempotency body: a replay recomputes it like the other upload URLs.

SessionIngestStatus.description: Outcome recorded for an accepted session.

SessionListItem.description:
`GET /v1/orgs/{id}/sessions` item: the [`SessionSummary`] plus list-only flags. The
summary members are flattened, so a list item is a superset of a summary.

participant_token.description: The pseudonymous token the device sent (CON-20).

research_frames_available.description:
A research frame log is stored for the session (RFL-6; same test as
`SessionDetail.research_frames.available` and the list's `frames=available`), so a
client can offer frame-level views without reading each session.

scoring_status.description:
SCH-5 scoring outcome of a schema 1.8 session; `null` for a 1.6 or 1.7 session (those
always carry score numbers). `unscorable`: the session has no scores; show "not
scored", never a number.

tracking_accuracy_deg.description: QS-2 estimated gaze accuracy, degrees; `null` when not measured (SCH-4).

tracking_verdict.description:
QS-4 tracking verdict of a schema 1.7 session; `null` for a 1.6 session or when the
device sent no tracking-quality record (SCH-4).

unscorable_reason.description: Why an `unscorable` session was not scored, when the device said; `null` otherwise.

SessionPerVideoScore.description:
One flattened per-clip row (`SessionPerVideoRow` in Swift; schema name
`SessionPerVideoScore`, which the Swift schema test looks up by name). snake_case.

A metric the clip did not measure, or measured only by imputation, is an absent key.

orienting_latency_ms.description: Measured first-entry latency; an imputed latency is not sent.

status.description: Worst row status of the clip; absent when the clip has no scored rows.

SessionQualityParams.description: `sessionQuality` (DSP-1, DSP-4, 1.3.0): the valid-frame ratios of the session verdict.

acceptableMinValidRatio.description: At or above (and below optimal): `acceptable`; below: `degraded`.

SessionRaw.description:
`GET /v1/sessions/{id}/raw`: the stored `rawPayload` for a sandbox re-score. De-identified:
the participant is the pseudonymous token only, and the free-text `notes` member of the
record is removed.

frames_available.description:
A frames blob is stored for the session (it is encrypted on the device; the API does
not serve it).

frames_purged.description: The retention sweep deleted the frames blob.

research_frames.description: The research frame log (RFL-6). Omitted (not `null`) when unknown.

schema_version.description: Wire form of the stored record (`1.6`, `1.7`, `1.8`).

SessionSide.description: One side (published or draft) of a per-session result row (RUN-3).

participant_token.description: The pseudonymous token the device sent (CON-20).

scoring_status.description:
SCH-5 scoring outcome of a schema 1.8 session; `null` for a 1.6 or 1.7 session (those
always carry score numbers). `unscorable`: the session has no scores; show "not
scored", never a number.

tracking_accuracy_deg.description: QS-2 estimated gaze accuracy, degrees; `null` when not measured (SCH-4).

tracking_verdict.description:
QS-4 tracking verdict of a schema 1.7 session; `null` for a 1.6 session or when the
device sent no tracking-quality record (SCH-4).

unscorable_reason.description: Why an `unscorable` session was not scored, when the device said; `null` otherwise.

glasses.description: Operator answer at the positioning step; `null` when not asked.

Sex.description:
Sex of the participant as a session may one day carry it (ADR-0012 Q8: session schema 1.9).
No session carries it yet, so a non-empty `CohortDefinition.sex` selects nothing extra and
is reported, never fabricated.

ShareLink.description: One share link (SHR-8), as listed. Never carries the passcode (see `CreatedShareLink`).

ShareLinkOpenResponse.description:
`200` answer to `POST /v1/share/{link_id}/open` (SHR-9). `download_token` is used once
as `GET /v1/share/{link_id}/file?t=<download_token>` within 5 minutes.

SignRequest.description:
Step-up signing body (SIGN-5), used by sign, cosign and letter finalize. The password
is verified and dropped; it is never stored or logged.

totp_code.description: Required when the user has TOTP enrolled.

SnapshotClip.description: One clip of the snapshot: every stored `MetricRow`, in display order.

SnapshotMeasurements.description: The stored session measurements shown on the review page (`SessionDetail` fields).

SocialPreferenceBand.description:
`display.bands.socialPreferencePct`, percent: `>= okMin` ok, `>= monitorMin` monitor.
Also the non-social bound (`100 - okMin`).

SshPublicKey.description:
`POST /v1/integrations/{id}/ssh-key` (INTG-5): generates (or rotates) the destination's
Ed25519 key and returns its public half.

Stage.description: Pipeline stage a parameter belongs to (groups and ordering in the UI).

SweepAxis.description:
One sweep axis (SWP-1): a Number or Integer registry id, `from <= to`, at most
[`MAX_SWEEP_STEPS`] steps, values inside the registry range.

SweepCell.description: One grid cell of a sweep (SWP-3).

changed_vs_published.description: Sessions whose flag differs from the published profile's.

SweepSpec.description: A parameter sweep (SWP-1, phase B): 1..=2 axes over the experiment profile.

published_values.description:
The published profile's value per axis: the cell the console marks. It is always a
cell; when it is off the grid it is the last one (SWP-2).

TimelineEntry.description: One timeline entry: headers only, never a note or letter body (CW-3).

id.description: Id of the underlying row (session id, review id, note id, letter id, care event id).

summary.description:
Kind-specific header: e.g. `{"attention_flag": "red"}`, `{"state": "final",
"version_no": 2}`, `{"note_kind": "general"}`, `{"letter_kind": "referral",
"status": "final"}`, `{"care_kind": "diary"}`. Never free text.

TimelineEntryKind.description: CW-3 timeline entry kinds; `encounter` and `attachment` are REC-5 (headers only).

TotpConfirmRequest.description:
`POST /v1/users/me/totp/confirm`: a current code from the pending seed (one step of
clock skew). `200 TotpStatus {totp_enrolled: true}`; `401 totp-invalid` for a wrong
code; `410 totp-enrolment-expired` without a live pending seed.

TotpDisableRequest.description:
`DELETE /v1/users/me/totp`: password and a current, unused code are both required.
`200 TotpStatus {totp_enrolled: false}`; `401 invalid-credentials` (password), `401
totp-required` (no code), `401 totp-invalid` (wrong or used code), `404
totp-not-enrolled`.

TotpEnforcement.description:
The caller's TOTP enforcement state (`UserProfile.totp_enforcement`, AUTH-11).

- `not_required`: the role is not in the required list, or TOTP is enrolled;
- `grace`: required, not enrolled, and the deadline is unset or still ahead (the
  console shows a nudge with the date);
- `required`: the deadline has passed; every route except reading the profile, the
  org shell and the enrolment routes answers `403 totp-enrolment-required`.

Older backends do not send the field; clients default it to `not_required`.

TotpEnrolRequest.description:
`POST /v1/users/me/totp/enrol` (any signed-in console user, 5 requests per minute per
user across the three TOTP routes). Answers `200 TotpEnrolResponse`; `401`
`invalid-credentials` for a wrong password, `409 totp-already-enrolled`, `503
clinical-crypto-unavailable` when the server has no data KEK. A second call replaces
the pending seed.

TotpEnrolResponse.description:
The pending seed: the only place it is ever shown in clear. Show it as a QR code of
`otpauth_url` and as text; it must be confirmed with `POST /v1/users/me/totp/confirm`
before `expires_at` (10 minutes).

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 time after which `confirm` answers `410 totp-enrolment-expired`.

secret.description: RFC 4648 base32 seed (20 random bytes, 32 characters, no padding).

TotpPolicy.description: Mandatory two-step sign-in policy (AUTH-11): users in `required_roles` without TOTP must enrol within `grace_days` of the first time they are seen; `UserProfile.totp_enforcement` reports the state. Owner-decided constants, not settings.

TotpResetRequest.description:
`POST /v1/orgs/{id}/users/{user_id}/totp/reset` (`UserTotpReset`: owner, admin): the
caller's step-up (SIGN-5: password, plus a code when the caller has TOTP) and why. The
password and code are verified and dropped; the reason goes into the audit row.
Answers `204`; the target signs in with the password alone and enrols again.

reason.description: 10..200 characters, stored in the audit row.

totp_code.description: Required when the caller has TOTP enrolled.

TrackingQualityParams.description:
Every threshold of the gaze-robustness spec (SCH-3). Each member is optional; a missing
member takes the default shown.

provisional.description: `true` until the bench replaces the literature defaults (BEN-6).

Unit.description: Display unit of a numeric parameter.

UnscorableReason.description: Why a session is `unscorable` (optional; absent when the device does not know).

UpdateEncounterRequest.description:
`PATCH /v1/encounters/{id}` with `If-Match: "<row_version>"` (REC-4). Absent fields
stay unchanged. A `closed` encounter accepts only `follow_up_done_at`, and `status:
open` from `owner` or `clinician`.

UpdateExperimentRequest.description:
`PATCH /v1/experiments/{id}` (`ExperimentWrite`, `If-Match`). `profile` is a whole
`ScoringProfile` document, validated by the parameter registry (PRM-3; `400
config-invalid` with `field_problems`).

UpdateProfileRequest.description:
`PATCH /v1/users/me`. Absent = unchanged, `""` = clear. Unknown fields are rejected
(role and status are never self-service).

locale.description:
I18N-11: absent = unchanged (`None`), `null` = clear the override (`Some(None)`), a
locale = set it.

display_name.description: Absent = unchanged, `""` = clear; up to 120 characters (NOTE-6).

professional_registration.description: Absent = unchanged, `""` = clear; up to 60 characters (NOTE-6).

org_id.description: `null` only for the global `superadmin`, who belongs to no org (AUTH-4).

UserProfile.description: `GET /v1/users/me`: the caller's account and signer profile.

effective_locale.description:
I18N-12: the locale for this request (user > org > `Accept-Language` > `en`).
Absent from older backends, hence the `en` default.

locale.description:
I18N-11: the user's locale override (`users.locale`); `null` = follow the org.
Absent from older backends.

totp_enforcement.description:
Mandatory two-step sign-in state for the caller's role (AUTH-11). Absent from older
backends, hence the `not_required` default.

totp_enrolled.description:
True when the user has a TOTP secret (the secret is never returned): a sign or
cosign then needs a `totp_code`.

totp_pending.description:
True while a TOTP enrolment waits for its confirming code and has not expired
(AUTH-10). Login and step-up ignore a pending seed.

totp_required_by.description:
RFC 3339 deadline for enrolling TOTP (AUTH-12), set the first time a user in a
required role without TOTP is seen and never moved; `null` until then. Returned as
stored, also when the current role no longer needs TOTP (`totp_enforcement` decides).

user_id.description: Same value as `id`, named for the console (sign / cosign checks).

UserStatus.description:
User account status. `invited` accounts exist but cannot sign in yet; only `active`
users can.

WorklistItem.description:
`GET /v1/orgs/{id}/worklist` item: the session plus its clinical review state. Never
carries impression or MRN (RBAC-4).

age_hours.description: Hours since the session was received.

has_patient_ref.description:
Whether a hospital MRN is on file (MRN-6). Absent for a caller without
`PatientRefRead` (superadmin); the MRN itself is never in this type.

participant_token.description: The pseudonymous token the device sent (CON-20).

review_id.description: `null` when no clinician has opened the review yet.

scoring_status.description:
SCH-5 scoring outcome of a schema 1.8 session; `null` for a 1.6 or 1.7 session (those
always carry score numbers). `unscorable`: the session has no scores; show "not
scored", never a number.

tracking_accuracy_deg.description: QS-2 estimated gaze accuracy, degrees; `null` when not measured (SCH-4).

tracking_verdict.description:
QS-4 tracking verdict of a schema 1.7 session; `null` for a 1.6 session or when the
device sent no tracking-quality record (SCH-4).

unscorable_reason.description: Why an `unscorable` session was not scored, when the device said; `null` otherwise.

WorklistScope.description:
CW-2 `settings.clinical.worklist_scope`; default `all` for clinic orgs, `flagged`
otherwise.
